messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated 5xx observed for dedicated EU embeddings pool eb-eu-2. Trigger time 2026-04-12T09:46Z. Affected tenant: Elysian Bank (dedicated).

ops-jay: Paging @oncall-rosemary and @eng-mike. Error spike aligned with a runtime deploy at ~09:40. Elysian accounts for ~12% of pool traffic.

oncall-rosemary: Acknowledged. Looking at proxy and runtime logs. Seeing repeated KV cache allocation failures and a few OOM-ish traces on g3-12-7. Autoscaler did not add pods automatically.

eng-mike: I'm pulling the deploy diff now. There's a GC-heuristics tweak for KV cache in the runtime that landed ~09:39. If that increased pressure we should rollback to previous runtime.

ops-jay: Quick repro: curl /v1/embeddings with a large batch shows intermittent 502/502. Snippets from proxy/runtime below:
```
[2026-04-12T09:45:03Z] proxy: upstream write error: broken pipe
[2026-04-12T09:45:03Z] kvcache: GC skipped, mem_usage=98% threshold=95%
[2026-04-12T09:45:04Z] model-runtime: failed to allocate KV slab
```

oncall-rosemary: Initiating rollback of the runtime change on eb-eu-2 canary. Also manually scaling the pool +2 nodes while rollback proceeds.

eng-mike: Rolling back commit b4f3c1 (kv-cache-gc-tuning). I will post status once rollback completes.

cs-ana: Heads-up: need a customer-facing note for Elysian. Who will send? @am-rkhan or ops can route?

am-rkhan: I will own outbound comms to Elysian. Send me a concise blurb I can forward to their SOC and account exec.

product-liz: Include ETA, mitigation actions, and statement about data integrity (no loss expected). Also mention which pool were rebalancing to (eb-eu-1).

oncall-rosemary: Rollback started 09:48 UTC. Pool scaling completed at 09:50 UTC (+2 nodes). Error rate dropping but were still seeing occasional spikes on older connections. Monitoring.

eng-mike: Rollback finished 09:51 UTC. Runtime rolled back on eb-eu-2. Telemetry shows 5xx from ~15% down to ~4% in the last 3 minutes.

ops-jay: Drafting status page update. Short draft below for approval: 

[Status] Partial degradation — Embeddings (EU dedicated pool)
Impact: Intermittent 5xx and increased latency for customers on eb-eu-2. Elysian Bank affected.
Mitigation: Rolled back a recent runtime change and added capacity; traffic is being rebalanced to eb-eu-1.
ETA: ~15 minutes for full recovery; will update as we see progress.

cs-ana: Customer blurb for Elysian SOC (non-technical):
"We detected elevated error rates affecting your dedicated EU embeddings environment. We identified a runtime change that increased cache pressure; weve rolled it back and added capacity. You may experience intermittent errors and latency while we rebalance traffic to a healthy pool. Estimated resolution within 20 minutes. No data loss expected. For urgent escalation contact r.khan@redwood.com."

am-rkhan: Approved. Please append the Elysian SLA contacts before sending. Ill route to their SOC and account execs.

oncall-rosemary: Current health: 5xx dropped to 2.8% (was ~15%), p95 latency improved from 350ms -> 140ms. No further KV allocation failures in the last 2 minutes.

eng-mike: Will watch for regressions. If 5xx > 5% sustained for 5 more minutes we will fail over all eb-eu-2 traffic to eb-eu-1.

ops-jay: Posted statuspage update: incident ID RDW-20260412-EU-embeds-02. Preparing DM/email to Elysian SOC now.

cs-ana: Outbound email queued — copy below. Sending to soc@elysianbank.com and ccing account team and AM.
---
To: soc@elysianbank.com
Cc: m.chen@elysianbank.com, r.khan@redwood.com
Subject: Service degradation — dedicated embeddings (EU) — update

Hi Elysian SOC,

We detected elevated error rates in your dedicated EU embeddings environment (eb-eu-2). We have rolled back a recent runtime change and added capacity; traffic is being rebalanced to a healthy pool (eb-eu-1). Estimated recovery within 20 minutes. No data loss expected. We will send a post-incident summary once the RCA is complete.

If you need immediate assistance please reply or contact r.khan@redwood.com.

Thanks,
Redwood Operations
---

am-rkhan: Sent at 09:56 UTC. Elysian acknowledged: "Thanks  we see errors and appreciate the quick response. Keep us posted."

product-liz: Capture remediation in incident doc: (1) rollback commit b4f3c1, (2) increase pool capacity, (3) tighten KV GC heuristics and add integration test for KV pressure, (4) postmortem and follow-up with Elysian.

oncall-rosemary: Monitoring for 30 minutes. If 5xx stays <3% for 15m we will mark P1 resolved and start RCA.

ops-jay: Updated internal routing playbook: dedicated pool incidents -> notify AM, CS, SRE, oncall lead. Playbook entry logged at /playbooks/dedicated-routing.md.

eng-mike: Opening PR to revert GC tuning branch and adding a regression test.

cs-ana: AM will coordinate customer post-incident comms. Closing loop after postmortem. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: UPDATE — mitigation in effect; customer notified. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.
